notes: CDER letter for a homeopathic ophthalmic-drops manufacturer: unapproved-new-drug charge for twelve named ophthalmic products (plus three additional named products raised as a concern though not currently on the US website), combined with CGMP violations for aseptic/media-fill representativeness, incomplete visual-inspection/sterility-testing records, and inadequate quality-unit oversight (21 CFR 211). Classified cgmp_sterile rather than unapproved_drug_marketing per the LightEyez precedent for a similarly-structured ophthalmic CGMP+unapproved-drug letter. No actual confirmed contamination event or organism is described (the findings are about inadequate validation/testing rigor, not detected contamination), but FDA explicitly asks for an action plan covering potential recalls of distributed batches, so recall_concern is true.
